Package engine

Class Game

java.lang.Object
engine.Game
public class Game extends Object
Central game engine. Holds all mutable game state as static fields and exposes methods for turn management, entity spawning, win/lose detection, and CSV hero loading.

onMapUpdate is a callback set by the View layer at startup so that the engine can trigger a UI refresh without importing the View package.

  • Method Details

    • loadHeroes

      public static void loadHeroes(String filePath) throws IOException
      Parses a CSV hero roster file and populates availableHeroes.

      Each row has the format: Name,TYPE,maxHp,maxActions,attackDamage where TYPE is EXP, FIGH, or MED.

      Parameters:
      filePath - path to the CSV file (relative to the working directory)
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file cannot be read

    • endTurn

      public static void endTurn() throws NotEnoughActionsException, InvalidTargetException
      Advances the game by one turn:
      1. Each zombie attacks an adjacent hero (if any).
      2. A new zombie spawns at a random empty cell.
      3. All cells are hidden (fog-of-war reset).
      4. Each active hero's action points are restored and visibility is recalculated.
      5. The map is redrawn via onMapUpdate.
      Throws:
      NotEnoughActionsException - propagated from zombie attack logic
      InvalidTargetException - propagated from zombie attack logic
